reproducer.description: scripts/snapshot_family.py at mncs-tui (demo-policy verdict mapping documented as non-canonical) plus examples/family_status.mncs projection contract.

requiredBehavior: A bounded, typed query returning per-repository verification state (identity, revision, verdict, evidence ref, staleness) consumable by projection surfaces without Git porcelain or private indexes.
summary: A terminal projection over the family needs one bounded query answering, per repository: latest verified revision, verdict (PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN), and evidence link. Today that state is scattered across Forge receipts, mncs-test result files, and git trees with no single query surface, so mncs-tui snapshots are assembled by a thin hand-written adapter over Atlas/git/Commons instead of a canonical projection feed.
title: No canonical per-repo verification-state query (projection snapshots stay hand-wired)
